summary: Comprehensive frontend UI/UX testing of Samarth Patel's Next.js 14 personal portfolio. Tested home page rendering, sticky navbar, hero (rotating role text, CTAs, profile card, floating badges), 6 featured projects (EchoOwl/Mystery Messages/Stream Sphere/Blog Platform/Group Chat Extension/Payment Integration) with correct action buttons, More Projects section, Experience timeline (DeepNeurons.ai + SmartInternz with certificate link), Skills (7 grouped categories, no percentages), Open Source empty state, Contact form (RHF+Zod validation + mailto fallback + Sonner toast), Footer, SEO meta/JSON-LD/robots/sitemap, mobile responsive with hamburger menu, and external link target=_blank+noopener attributes. All 76 assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact form uses window.location.href = mailto: which works but note that on some browsers this can leave the current page in an inconsistent state; verified with request interception that the constructed mailto URL is correct: mailto:samp231004@gmail.com?subject=Portfolio%20inquiry%20from%20{name}&body=Name%3A%20...%0AEmail%3A%20...%0A{message} — subject and body are properly URL-encoded.

Non-blocking font preload warnings observed for /_next/static/media/*.woff2 (preloaded but not used within a few seconds). This is a known Next.js Geist font loader warning and does not affect functionality.
All external links across the site (30 total) correctly have target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer.
IntersectionObserver-based active nav underline works, Framer Motion rotator cycles roles every 2.4s, no animation regressions detected (no opacity:0 stuck elements).
seed_data_creation: None (static portfolio site with no backend)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portfolio site is Next.js 14 App Router at https://samarth-portfolio-1.preview.emergentagent.com/. No backend. Contact form uses mailto: fallback — to verify mailto URL construction use Playwright request interception (page.on('request')) since window.location.href is not easily hijackable via JS. All data-testids follow kebab-case: nav-link-*, mobile-nav-link-*, nav-social-*, hero-view-work-button, hero-resume-button, hero-social-*, hero-role-rotator, availability-badge, profile-card, project-live-echoowl/mystery-messages/stream-sphere/blog-platform/payment-integration, project-github-*, project-android-echoowl, contact-{name,email,phone,message}-input, contact-submit-button, contact-{email,phone}-link, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, site-navbar, logo-link, hero-section, contact-section. Sticky navbar verified (top=0 before and after scroll). All 76 test assertions passed including form validation, mailto construction, SEO meta, responsive mobile menu, and external link security attributes.
